question: A person on anti-tubercular drugs complained of deafness and tinnitus in one ear. Drug implicated is?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Anti-tubercular drugs" -> "possible side effects" -> "ototoxicity" -> "deafness and tinnitus" -> "Streptomycin" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Anti-tubercular drugs" -> "common side effects" -> "neuropathy" -> "not typically associated with deafness" -> "Isoniazid unlikely" -> 75%
CHAIN: "Anti-tubercular drugs" -> "Ethambutol" -> "visual disturbances" -> "not associated with hearing loss" -> "Ethambutol unlikely" -> 80%
CHAIN: "Anti-tubercular drugs" -> "Rifampicin" -> "hepatotoxicity" -> "not associated with deafness" -> "Rifampicin unlikely" -> 80%
CHAIN: "Streptomycin" -> "known ototoxicity" -> "deafness and tinnitus" -> "most likely implicated drug" -> 90%
analysis: Streptomycin is known to cause ototoxicity, which can lead to symptoms such as deafness and tinnitus. The other drugs listed (Isoniazid, Ethambutol, and Rifampicin) are not typically associated with these auditory side effects.
